entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT
entities.description: Network-initiated message sent to reject a PDU session modification request.

entities.name: PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure for modifying an existing PDU session, which may be rejected by the network.

entities.name: 5GSM cause
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for rejection of the PDU session modification.

relations.description: The PDU session modification procedure includes the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message as a possible response.
The PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message contains the 5GSM cause information element to indicate the rejection reason.
